Road 0: TEXT
Read each column top-to-bottom in order. Player exhausts a column's events before moving on. Order within a column is fixed except for the optional Wander Around tries.

Intros are mandatory ONCE per facility per save. They are simple and clean. Build-affecting intros (Move Tutor, Stone Sage, Nature Rater, Battle Dojo, EV Trainer, Fan Club) NEVER force a learn/equip action - they instead hand the player a one-time VOUCHER to try the NPC at no cost.
Functional intros (Pokémon Center, Party Sort, Bag, PC, Artifact enable/disable, Relic Annex, Daycare) MAY force the player to perform the action once. These don't affect build composition.

Once a facility's mandatory intro has fired, later visits show a 'visited' presence with no re-intro. Exception: a STAGE-UP intro fires once per tier upgrade (Move Tutor -> Expert at C2 then Guru at C5, Stone Sage -> Stones at C4, Battle Dojo -> Black Belt at C6 then Grandmaster at C8).
Daycare's first-time intro fires at C2 only. C4 and C6 reappearances are visited presence (no re-intro). The single static egg can be picked up at any visit, the parent is permanently consumed.
Main Story events and battles fire on EVERY run on their assigned roads. Always-on.

Villain Story events and battles fire ONLY when the run's assigned villain is the corresponding team. One villain team per run drawn from: Rocket / Magma / Aqua / Galactic / Plasma / Flare / Skull / Yell / Macro Cosmos / Star.

Extra Story events and raids fire ONLY when the run's assigned extra is the corresponding Pokémon horror. One extra per run drawn from: Cubone / Yamask / Hypno / Phantump / Mimikyu / Drifloon / Parasect / Mewtwo.

Pre-Battle Dialogue and Post-Battle Dialogue fire around every NAMED opponent: Gym Trainers (#), Gym Leaders, Rivals, Story Battles, Mini-Bosses, Bosses, Elite Four, Champion, Mystery Figure. Outcome-aware: post-dialogue branches on win/loss but always fires.
Wild Encounter and unnamed Basic Trainer fights use a short shared shoutout line (no full pre/post dialogue). Keeps route pacing tight.

Each Road has 3-4 trainer fights total (Wild Encounters and Story Events do NOT count - only Battle entries). Base regular trainer count is 2 (with Rival on R3 and R6 the count climbs to 3). Story Battles (Main / Villain / Extra) substitute for regular trainer fights to stay <= 4.
When a route's gated story battles push count above 4, drop fights in this order: Basic Trainer FIRST, then Elite Trainer. NEVER drop Rival Match or Story Battle entries.
NO auto-heal between fights on a Road. HP and PP carry across encounters within a single route. Player may USE BAG ITEMS (Potions / Revives / Status heals) between fights to top up.
AUTO-HEAL on city entry. Pokémon Center entries are free. ALL fights inside a city (Gym Trainers / Gym Leaders / League battles / Mystery Figure) auto-heal beforehand.
Lose any battle -> return to the last city, free heal, lose 20% of current gold. PP/HP fully restored. (Tuned down from 50% based on playtest - keeps the puzzle-retry vibe.)
Achievement: clear the game without losing a single battle. End-of-run banner if achieved.

Optional after a route's mandatory events. Max 3 tries. Wild encounter chance: 50% / 25% / 12.5%. Halves on subsequent tries after a hit. Pure flavor / catching / training - does not advance the story timeline.

HP-Threshold Phases (universal). The boss gains a new move or stat boost at 50% HP and again at 25% HP. Telegraphed by a phase-banner ONE TURN BEFORE the trigger. The backbone of every boss/raid/mini-boss encounter.

Immunity Round (telegraphed). Every ~5 rounds the boss takes no damage for one turn but can still be afflicted by status. The pre-immunity turn shows a clear 'BOSS IS PREPARING' banner. Rewards status/setup play and punishes pure DPS.

Theme-Matched Field Lock. When the boss's type fits a field, lock weather/terrain/stadium for N turns matching it (Magma -> harsh sun, Aqua -> heavy rain, Plasma -> psychic terrain, Galactic -> distortion, etc.). Field-empowered moves get the standard +50% boost.

Fallback when the field-lock theme does not fit. Pick one each fight (no surprises): (a) +25% damage on the boss's STAB moves for 3 turns ('POWER SURGE' banner), or (b) +1 priority on the boss's next move ('BOSS MOVES FIRST' banner). Always telegraphed one turn ahead.
Every mechanic is ANTICIPATED (banner one turn before activation) and CLEAN (no hidden RNG and no surprise mechanic introductions mid-fight). Player should always know what's coming.
Max HP = base HP × (party size - 1). Stats scaled from a same-type legendary or scale-matched. Few phases. Easier. Team vs. 1 boss Pokémon.
Max HP = base HP × party size. Stats scaled from a same-type legendary. Full-scale multi-phase. Hard. Team vs. 1 boss Pokémon.
Themed Trainer battle with Raid-Boss phases applied to the trainer's lead/strongest mon. Easier and fewer phases than a Boss Battle. Uses regular battle mechanics + the mechanic toolbox above.
Themed Trainer battle with Raid-Boss phases applied to the trainer's lead/strongest mon. Hard multi-phase. Uses regular battle mechanics + the full mechanic toolbox.
Dialogue or simple multiple-choice scene. Develops story / hands item / drops clue. NEVER combat.
Queued after Gym Leader 8. The Sighting Cinematic fires once on Road 8 with per-variant framing + per-species lore. Then transitions to the Catch Encounter (one-throw catch or it's gone forever).
